items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Yes, he did a lot of everything Buddy Bolton did in that day. ... Buddy Bolton. Yeah. He was a cracker jack in that day.

ctx.x: A lot of triple, did you say? Did he do triple work?
Yes, he did a lot of everything Buddy Bolton did in that day.
Loud. Was that triple tone? Could he do triple tone?
